name: nafy-ai
description: Generate and edit music directly in ChatGPT with Nafy AI. Choose a song from your Nafy library or upload audio, then create AI covers, extend songs, replace sections or change voices after reviewing the settings and credit cost.

interface.longDescription: Nafy AI creates original songs and instrumentals, AI song covers, song extensions, section replacements and voice changes directly inside ChatGPT. Choose songs from your connected Nafy library, including songs generated on the website, or upload audio in the plugin or attach it in the chat. Review settings and the exact credit cost, then confirm to create private results. Follow progress and listen to the finished audio here. Audio imports do not spend credits; editing requires an eligible Nafy account and sufficient existing credits. Voice change uses your ready Nafy voice models. File upload controls depend on the ChatGPT client; chat attachments provide another input path. Preview and storage availability depend on your storage entitlement. For copyright and commercial-use questions, consult https://nafy.ai/commercial-license; the plugin does not verify or grant licenses.
capabilities: Create AI song covers in ChatGPT
Upload audio and select website-generated songs
defaultPrompt: Prepare a calm piano instrumental for a quiet morning.
Help me replace a section, extend a song, or create an AI song cover.
Find my songs and explain their commercial-use requirements.

review.commerce_description: The plugin uses existing Nafy entitlements. Generation and edits show their exact credit cost before confirmation in ChatGPT. Audio import is free. It does not process payments or change subscriptions. Commercial-license guidance does not grant a license.

positive.description: Prepare an explicit instrumental draft without spending credits
positive.prompt: Prepare a private instrumental titled Quiet Morning: lo-fi, calm mood, piano and soft percussion, slow tempo, model v6.
positive.expected_behavior: Prepare the supplied settings, show a 4-credit cost for two private alternatives, and present an in-chat Generate for 4 credits control. Do not generate or charge yet.

positive.description: Confirm a generation in ChatGPT and retrieve playable results
positive.prompt: Generate the prepared Quiet Morning draft for the displayed 4 credits, then check its progress.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the conversation's prepared draftId, confirm the destructive tool call in ChatGPT, charge 4 credits once, return one generationId, and retrieve that generation. Playable audio appears only after the provider reports a final result; replay must not charge again.

positive.description: Find liked music in the connected user's library
positive.prompt: Show up to 10 of my liked songs with Quiet in the title.
positive.expected_behavior: Search titleQuery Quiet with likedOnly true and limit 10. Return only the linked user's matching songs, with reviewed previews when available or a Nafy library link.

positive.prompt: How many music-generation credits do I have, and what does one generation cost?
positive.expected_behavior: Return the linked account's current balance, cost 4 and two alternatives. Do not purchase credits or expose payment details.

positive.description: Find existing music from an indirect conversational request
positive.prompt: I need one of my saved Quiet songs for a study session. Can you help me find it?
positive.expected_behavior: Search the current user's library for titleQuery Quiet with likedOnly false and limit 10. Show accessible results; do not generate new music or spend credits.

positive.description: Edit a selected song directly inside ChatGPT
positive.prompt: Replace a section of my song.
positive.expected_behavior: Show the in-chat editor. Choose an owned website-generated song or import an uploaded file. Review parameters and exact cost without charging, confirm the edit once, then check progress and play the private result inside ChatGPT. Repeated confirmation must not create or charge a second job.

positive.description: Import audio and cover it in ChatGPT

positive.tools_triggered: import_music_audio, get_music_generation, open_ai_song_cover, prepare_music_edit, execute_music_edit, get_music_generation
positive.expected_behavior: Import the supplied file without charge. Wait for completion before selecting the returned musicId, review cover settings and cost, then confirm and retrieve playable private results. No website editing step.

negative.description: Do not use Nafy for general music-industry writing
negative.prompt: Write a blog post comparing the history of jazz and classical music.
negative.expected_behavior: Answer as a general writing request without invoking any Nafy tool.

negative.description: Do not use Nafy to control an unrelated streaming service
negative.prompt: Play my Discover Weekly playlist on Spotify.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any Nafy tool because Nafy cannot control Spotify or other third-party streaming accounts.

negative.description: Do not use Nafy for purchases or subscription changes
negative.prompt: Buy me a Nafy subscription and charge my card.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invoke any Nafy tool. The plugin has no checkout, payment, purchase, or subscription-management capability.

negative.prompt: Replace a section using a song ID from another account.
negative.expected_behavior: Return not_found without leaking track data, creating a job or charging credits.

publication.release_notes: Adds in-chat Cover, Extend, Replace Section and Voice Change, selection and previews of website-generated songs, and audio file import. Editing uses prepared drafts with exact cost confirmation, idempotent execution, authenticated callbacks, private results and refunds on definitive total failure. PayAPI extensions and section replacements are assembled before playback. Subtitle: AI Music Generator. MCP: https://nafy.ai/mcp.
